description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing report schedules in a multi-tenant accounting backend. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, fetching logs, and triggering report schedules, secured with authentication and company context validation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/schedules to list all report schedules for the company.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /api/schedules to create a new report schedule with specified options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/schedules/:id to retrieve a specific report schedule.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to /api/schedules/:id to update an existing report schedule.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to /api/schedules/:id to delete a specific report schedule.

methods.name: logs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/schedules/:id/logs to list delivery logs for a schedule.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /api/schedules/:id/trigger to trigger a schedule immediately for testing.
